tasks.goal: Recover from invalid input and save the corrected interval, then save another valid edit
tasks.starting_state: Fresh V7Q case in own isolated synthetic browser
actions: Correct to a valid whole number and save
Change to another valid interval and save
decisions: Submit a representative invalid interval before correcting it
Read validation, entered correction and saved confirmation
Make a further valid edit without reloading
success_criteria: A valid correction visibly saves Fern with the intended interval
A subsequent different valid edit saves the newly intended interval
recovery_criteria: A representative invalid interval does not save and produces actionable validation
Correction and resubmission work without reload, retaining entered correction and clearing obsolete error
stop_conditions: Stop at sixty total attempted actions or twelve minutes from first UI action
Stop on real data, external navigation, uncertain execution or expired lease

obligations.description: Representative invalid value is rejected with actionable validation
Representative valid value is saved with correct Fern interval
Empty, nonnumeric, fractional and other out-of-range variants
obligations.exclusion_reason: Representative invalid value only; full input-class matrix is outside this bounded plan

obligations.description: Correct invalid input and resubmit without reload or loss, clearing error
Save another valid edit in the same page

tasks.goal: Cancel a removal without changing the queue, then intentionally remove one episode
tasks.starting_state: Fresh J2N case in own isolated synthetic browser
decisions: Inspect both episodes and count before removal
Cancel first and check order and count
Request removal again and confirm only the intended episode
success_criteria: Confirmed removal closes dialog and leaves only River Sounds with count one
recovery_criteria: Opening confirmation does not change initial episodes, order or count
Cancel closes dialog and preserves both episodes in order with count two
stop_conditions: Stop at sixty total attempted actions or twelve minutes from first UI action
Stop on real data, external navigation, uncertain execution or expired lease

obligations.description: Removal confirmation opens without changing queue
Cancel closes and preserves both episodes, order and count
Another removal request works after cancel
Confirm removes only Morning Birds, retains River Sounds, closes dialog and count is one

tasks.goal: Retain the chosen preference through the required outage and retry, then compare the alternative
tasks.starting_state: Fresh H8C case in own isolated synthetic browser
actions: Use explicit Retry preview without re-entering preference
Choose Shortest path and preview again
decisions: Choose the nondefault preference before preview
Treat the first simulated outage as expected and retry without re-entry
Read route name, distance and stairs before switching preference
success_criteria: Successful retry shows Riverside ramp, 1.2 km, no stairs for Avoid stairs
Later Shortest path preview shows Hill steps, 0.8 km, includes stairs without another outage
recovery_criteria: First preview shows the required temporary outage and explicit retry without changing preference
Retry preserves preference, needs no re-entry and clears the outage
stop_conditions: Stop at sixty total attempted actions or twelve minutes from first UI action
Stop on real data, external navigation, uncertain execution or expired lease

obligations.description: Nondefault choice persists through required first outage and explicit Retry
Retry preserves chosen preference and clears error without re-entry
Avoid stairs route identity, distance and stairs are correct
Subsequent choice change previews correct alternate without another outage
